identity.name: KOZSAĞ GROUP İNŞAAT
identity.vibe: The Monolith. Solid, expensive, serene. A mix of raw stone textures and refined metal accents.

usage_rules.h1: text-6xl md:text-8xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[0.9] text-primary
usage_rules.h2: text-4xl md:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-primary mb-12
usage_rules.label: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-accent font-bold
usage_rules.nav: text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-widest font-medium hover:text-accent transition-colors

textures.noise: opacity-5 pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 mix-blend-multiply

HeroSection.description: Full-screen cinematic experience. Image dominates. Text is minimal and anchored.
HeroSection.layout: h-screen relative overflow-hidden flex items-end pb-24
elements: Background Image: Full cover, slow zoom animation (scale 1.0 to 1.05 over 20s).
Overlay: Gradient from bottom-black/60 to transparent (h-1/2).
Content: Bottom-left aligned. Massive H1 ('STONE & LEGACY'). Small refined CTA.
Scroll Indicator: Animated vertical line or mouse icon at bottom center.

ProjectGallery.description: The 'Tamamlanan Projeler' section. A pure visual grid. No text clutter.
ProjectGallery.layout: Grid Mode A (Tetris). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-8
ProjectGallery.item_style: aspect-[3/4] or aspect-square relative group overflow-hidden cursor-pointer
ProjectGallery.interaction: Image scale on hover. NO TEXT visible by default. On hover, a very subtle overlay with project name can appear, OR keep it purely visual as requested.
ProjectGallery.rule: STRICTLY NO TEXT UNDER IMAGES. The grid must look like an art gallery wall.

AboutSection.description: Asymmetrical layout. Text on one side, massive image on the other.
AboutSection.typography: Use 'label' style for 'OUR PHILOSOPHY'. H2 for 'Building for Eternity'.
AboutSection.decoration: Use a vertical line separator (border-l border-copper) for the text block.

ContactForm.input_style: bg-transparent border-b border-stone-300 focus:border-copper px-0 py-4 rounded-none outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-stone-400
ContactForm.button_style: bg-primary text-white px-12 py-4 hover:bg-copper transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest text-sm

Chatbot.description: A premium concierge, not a support bot.
Chatbot.style: Fixed bottom-right. Button is a circle with a refined icon (not a robot face). Window is clean, sharp corners, minimal shadow.

hero.alt: Luxury stone villa exterior at dusk

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a site for a client who values SILENCE and SPACE. Do not clutter. If in doubt, add more padding.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Use the existing /app/frontend/src structure. Modify App.css for global styles, but prefer Tailwind classes in components.
critical_rules: Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Use Playfair Display for headings, Manrope for body.
Do NOT put text under project images. The gallery must be clean.
Use the 'stone' color palette defined above. Avoid pure white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds; use #F5F5F0.
Ensure the 'Tamamlanan Projeler' section uses the provided project images in a masonry or grid layout.
The Chatbot should feel like a luxury service (Concierge), not a tech support tool.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for scroll reveals. Images should have a slow parallax effect. Text should fade up slowly.

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios are met. Use aria-labels for image-only buttons.
